import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
di=G['Demo pair 1 input']; do=G['Demo pair 1 output']
diff=[(r,c,di[r][c],do[r][c]) for r in range(len(di)) for c in range(len(di[0])) if di[r][c]!=do[r][c]]

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bar = full line of 2s
    bar_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    bar_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    assert len(bar_rows)+len(bar_cols)==1
    shape=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    sr={r for r,_ in shape}; sc={c for _,c in shape}
    if bar_rows:
        br=bar_rows[0]; oth='v'; barpos=br
        def near(e): return e>br
        def far(e): return e<e0 if False else None
    else:
        bc=bar_cols[0]; oth='h'; barpos=bc
        def near(c): return c>bc
    if oth=='v':
        # move vertically toward bar
        low=max(sr); high=min(sr)
        if near(low):  # shape above bar
            nb=barpos-1; nblow=None; nhigh=None
            nt=(nb-high)-... 
            # delta so new_low = bar-1 -> delta= nb-high-? new = old+delta; new_low = high+delta = bar-1
            delta=barpos-high-1
        else: delta=barpos-low+1
        ns={(r+delta,c) for r,c in shape}
        wall_r = (high+delta) if near(low) else (low+delta)-1
        wall=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r==wall_r]
        # connector: old shape all same column and wall column aligns
        conn=[]
        if len(sc)==1 and sc=={c for _,c in [(r,cc) for r,cc in []]}:
            pass
        # simpler: single column overall
        if len(sc)==1:
            c0=list(sc)[0]
            lo,hi=min(sr),max(sr)
            conn=[(r,c0) for r in range(lo,hi+1) if r!=wall_r]
        out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r,c in wall: out[r][c]=8
        for r,c in conn:
            if out[r][c]!=8 and g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=8
        for r,c in ns: out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    else:
        l=min(sc); r_=max(sc)
        if near(l):  # shape left of bar
            delta=barpos-l+1
        else: delta=barpos-r_-1
        ns={(r,c+delta) for r,c in shape}
        wall_c = (l+delta) if near(l) else (r_+delta)-1
        wall=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if c==wall_c]
        out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r,c in wall: out[r][c]=8
        # connector single row
        if len(sr)==1:
            r0=list(sr)[0]
            lo,hi=min(sr),max(sr)
            conn=[(r0,c) for c in range(min(sc),max(sc)+1) if c!=wall_c]
            for r,c in conn:
                if out[r][c]!=8 and g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=8
        for r,c in ns: out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    return out

import itertools
def analyze(i):
    ii=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; oo=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H,W=len(ii),len(ii[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in ii for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if ii[r][c] not in (bg,2)}
    # comps restricted to non-bg non-2
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in cells:
        if p in seen: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            q=stack.pop()
            if q in seen: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                a,b=q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc
                if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and (a,b) in cells: stack.append((a,b))
        comps.append(comp)
    bars_r=[r for r in range(H) if sum(1 for c in range(W) if ii[r][c]==2)==W]
    bars_c=[c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for r in range(H) if ii[r][c]==2)==H]
    info={'ii':ii,'oo':oo,'H':H,'W':W,'bg':bg,'cells':cells,'comps':comps,'br':bars_r,'bc':bars_c}
    return info

from collections import Counter

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    shp=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    br=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    bc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H))]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if br:
        bar_r=br[0]; oth='v'; axis=0
        rs=[r for r,_ in shp]
        below = max(rs) > bar_r
        dr = bar_r - max(rs) - 1 if below else min(rs) - bar_r - 1
        ns={(r+dr,c) for r,c in shp}
        trail_r = max(rs)+dr+1 if below else min(rs)+dr-1
    else:
        bar_c=bc[0]; oth='h'; axis=1
        cs=[c for _,c in shp]
        right = max(cs) > bar_c
        dc = bar_c - max(cs) - 1 if right else min(cs) - bar_c - 1
        ns={(r,c+dc) for r,c in shp}
        trail_c = max(cs)+dc+1 if right else min(cs)+dc-1
    # fill trail: background cells only
    for j in range(H):
        if axis=='v' and out[j][trail_c]==bg: out[j][trail_c]=8
    for j in range(W):
        if axis=='h' and out[trail_r][j]==bg: out[trail_r][j]=8
    for r,c in ns: out[r][c]=g[r][c]  # keep original color, may overlap trail
    return out

ok=True
for i in range(1,5):
    p=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])
    q=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    m=p==q
    ok&=m
    print(i,m)
print('ALL',ok)
import json
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import os,re
def load():

    bc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H))]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in cells:
        if p in seen: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            q=stack.pop()
            if q in seen: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.add(q)
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                a,b=q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc
                if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and (a,b) in cells and (a,b) not in seen: stack.append((a,b))
        comps.append(comp)
    b=br[0] if br else bc[0]

    if br:
        comps.sort(key=lambda cp: min(abs(b-p[0]) for p in cp))
        for comp in comps:
            rs={r for r,_ in comp}; cs={c for _,c in comp}
            down=max(rs)>b
            cand=[]
            for k_ in range(-H,H+1):
                if any(r+k_<0 or r+k_>H for r,_ in comp): continue
                if any(r+k_==b for r,_ in comp): continue
                if not any(abs(r+k_-b)==1 for r,_ in comp): continue
                if not all(out[r+k_][c]==bg for r,c in comp): continue

            dd=min(cand) if cand else None
            fr=max(rs)+dd if down else min(rs)+dd
            tc=fr+1 if down else fr-1
            for c in range(W):
                if out[tc][c]!=2: out[tc][c]=8
            for r,c in comp: out[r+dd][c]=g[r][c]
    else:
        for comp in comps:
            rs={r for r,_ in comp}; cs={c for _,c in comp}
            right=max(cs)>b
            cand=[]
            for k_ in range(-W,W+1):
                if any(c+k_<0 or c+k_>=W for _,c in comp): continue
                if any(c+k_==b for _,c in comp): continue
                if not any(abs(c+k_-b)==1 for _,c in comp): continue
                if not all(out[r][c+k_]==bg for r,c in comp): continue
                cand.append(k_)
            dd=min(cand) if cand else None
            fc=max(cs)+dd if right else min(cs)+dd
            tr=fc+1 if right else fc-1
            for r in range(H):
                if out[r][tr]!=2: out[r][tr]=8
            for r,c in comp: out[r][c+dd]=g[r][c]
    return out

def f(a):
    H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in a for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # anchor lines: full row or col of a single non-bg color
    ar=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(a[r]))==1 and a[r][0]!=bg]
    ac=[c for c in range(W) if len({a[i][c] for i in range(H)})==1 and a[0][c]!=bg]
    anc_c=a[ar[0]][0] if ar else a[0][ac[0]]
    objc=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bg and c!=anc_c][0]
    shp={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i][j]==objc}
    out=[list(r) for r in a]
    if ar:      # horizontal anchor -> move vertically
        an_r=ar[0]
        if max(i for i,_ in shp) < an_r:   # object above anchor: slide down so bottom = an_r-1
            k=(an_r-1)-max(i for i,_ in shp)
            fr=max(i for i,_ in shp)+k+1
        else:                                   # object below anchor: slide up so top = an_r+1
            k=(an_r+1)-min(i for i,_ in shp)
            fr=min(i for i,_ in shp)+k-1
        for i,j in shp: out[i+k][j]=objc
        for j in range(W): out[fr][j]=8
    else:      # vertical anchor -> move horizontally
        an_c=ac[0]
        if min(j for _,j in shp) > an_c:   # object right of anchor: slide left so right = an_c-1
            k=(an_c-1)-max(j for _,j in shp)
            fc=max(j for _,j in shp)+k+1
        else:                               # object left of anchor: slide right so left = an_c+1
            k=(an_c+1)-min(j for _,j in shp)
            fc=min(j for _,j in shp)+k-1
        for i,j in shp: out[i][j+k]=objc
        for i in range(H): out[i][fc]=8
    return out
for n in ['4','5','6']:
    ok=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,ok)

from collections import Counter
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(a):
    H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in a for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(a[r]))==1 and next(iter(set(a[r])))!=bg]
    ac=[c for c in range(W) if len({a[i][c] for i in range(H)})==1 and a[0][c]!=bg]
    kind='row' if ar else 'col'
    ancpos = ar[0] if kind=='row' else ac[0]
    anc=a[ancpos] if kind=='row' else [a[i][ancpos] for i in range(H)][0]
    objc=max(c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bg and c!=anc)
    shp={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i][j]==objc}
    out=[list(r) for r in a]
    def ext():
        if kind=='row':
            return min(i for i,_ in shp), max(i for i,_ in shp)
        else:
            return min(j for _,j in shp), max(j for _,j in shp)
    lo,hi=ext()
    if kind=='row':
        # move vertically toward anchor; stop when figure touches anchor line
        if ancpos > hi:   # below anchor: move UP
            dr=-1; tgt=ancpos-1          # bottom -> ancpos-1 (touching)
            k=tgt-hi
            far=lo+k-1                    # beyond far (top) face
        else:             # above anchor: move DOWN
            dr=1; tgt=ancpos+1           # top -> ancpos+1
            k=tgt-lo
            far=hi+k+1
        if k!=0:
            for i,j in shp: out[i+k][j]=objc
        for j in range(W): out[far][j]=8
    else:
        if ancpos > hi:   # left of anchor: move RIGHT
            dr=1; tgt=ancpos+1
            k=tgt-lo
            far=hi+k+1
            for i,j in shp: out[i][j+k]=objc
            for i in range(H): out[i][far]=8
        elif ancpos < lo: # right of anchor: move LEFT
            dr=-1; tgt=ancpos-1
            k=tgt-hi
            far=lo+k-1
            for i,j in shp: out[i][j+k]=objc
            for i in range(H): out[i][far]=8
    return out
for n in ['4','5','6']:
    ok=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, ok)
    if not ok:
        g1,g2=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']),G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
        for r in range(len(g1)):
            if g1[r]!=g2[r]: print(''.join(map(str,g1[r])),'|',''.join(map(str,g2[r])))
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

G=load()
def bbox(cells):
    return (min(i for i,_ in cells), max(i for i,_ in cells), min(j for _,j in cells), max(j for _,j in cells))
def cells_of(a,color):
    return {(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(a) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==color}
for n in ['4','5','6']:
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(gi[r]))==1 and next(iter(set(gi[r])))!=bg]
    ac=[c for c in range(W) if len({gi[i][c] for i in range(H)})==1 and gi[0][c]!=bg]
    kind='row' if ar else 'col'; apos=ar[0] if ar else ac[0]
    anc=gi[apos] if kind=='row' else gi[0][apos]
    objc=max(c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bg and c!=anc)
    shp=cells_of(gi,objc)
    print('=== demo',n,'kind',kind,'bg',bg,'anc',anc,'obj',objc,'bbox',bbox(shp),'anchor@',apos,'H,W',H,W)
    # final extent of obj in output
    shpo=cells_of(go,objc)
    print('   out obj bbox',bbox(shpo))
    eight={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]==8 and gi[i][j]!=8}
    print('   8 cells',sorted(eight))
